name: wc-jupyter
description: Jupyter notebooks on the web-chat surface: open one or more .ipynb files as tabs in a single pane, see every cell and its real outputs rendered natively, and run cells against a Jupyter kernel the user is already serving. A companion run-console pane reads the same store and ships no service of its own. The pack's one host service speaks the Jupyter Server REST + WebSocket protocol directly with no Python and no npm dependencies, publishes `jpy_conn`, `jpy_nb` and per-cell `jpy_out_<id>`, It writes notebooks only through that server's contents API, only cell source, and refuses to save a notebook that changed on disk or that it is holding truncated.
